Looking at this quotation, the specific mechanism is: a formal government oversight notification ("best value notice") issued by a central department to a local authority, requiring the authority to demonstrate improvement and engage with the department for assurance purposes.

This is about intergovernmental relations — specifically central government oversight and accountability of a local authority regarding "best value" (a statutory duty in UK local government law requiring efficient and effective service delivery). The substance is the regulatory/oversight relationship between tiers of government.

The primary classification is H7 (State and Local Government • Intergovernmental Relations), as this is squarely about a central department exercising oversight over a local authority.

There's also a K2 (Regulation and Business Law) dimension, as this is a formal legal/regulatory instrument (a statutory notice under best value legislation), but the intergovernmental dimension is more substantive here.
